name: Fall of Granada and End of Reconquista
summary: On 2 January 1492, Muhammad XII (Boabdil) surrendered the city and palace complex of Granada to Ferdinand and Isabella, ending the Nasrid Emirate of Granada and completing the eight-century Christian reconquest of Iberia. The surrender terms were initially generous but were violated within a decade. Later in 1492, Columbus sailed westward; the same year the Jews of Spain were expelled under the Alhambra Decree.
outcomes: Last Muslim emirate in Iberia surrenders

_quarry.structural_significance: The symbolic culmination of the Reconquista; the unified Iberian monarchy emerging from the conquest would project power globally within decades.
